为每个新鲜 Writer 构造两轮原生消息，仅保存后生效。: Build two rounds of native messages for every fresh Writer. Changes take effect only after saving.
仅作用于新开始运行中的 Writer；当前运行、主模型和任务子代理不受影响。关闭: Applies only to Writers in newly started runs. Current runs, the main model and task subagents are unchanged. Turn off to save unfinished drafts.
消息顺序：系统提示词 → 两轮预置历史 → 本次写作上下文。历史工具不会执行，也: Order: system prompt → two preset rounds → current writing context. Historical tools are not executed and do not grant real Writer tool permissions.
1–64 位英文字母、数字、下划线或连字符。调用 ID 自动生成并配对。: 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Call IDs are generated and paired automatically.
关闭表示成功；开启表示工具返回错误。: Off means success; on means the tool returned an error.
参数和结果必须是对象型 JSON；数字原文无损保留。最多 20,000 个编译字: Arguments and results must be JSON objects; numeric source text is preserved losslessly. Maximum: 20,000 compiled characters and 262,144 configuration bytes.
配置超过大小限制。: The configuration exceeds the size limit.
关闭注入后可以保存草稿；启用前必须完成全部校验。: Turn off injection to save a draft. All validation must pass before enabling.
将清空当前编辑内容并关闭注入。点击保存后才会替换已保存的配置。: This clears the draft and turns off injection. The stored configuration is replaced only when you save.
这是注入的预置历史，不是本次运行的工具执行或模型输出。: This is injected preset history, not a tool execution or model output from this run.
工具名限 1–64 位英文字母、数字、下划线或连字符。: Tool names require 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.
参数必须是合法的对象型 JSON。: Arguments must be a valid JSON object.
结果必须是合法的对象型 JSON。: The result must be a valid JSON object.
编译后的 Writer 预置历史不能超过 20,000 字符。: Compiled Writer preset history must not exceed 20,000 characters.
Writer 预置历史已被更新，请重新读取后再保存。: Writer preset history has changed. Reload it before saving.
保存的 Writer 预置历史无法读取，请检查数据库或从备份恢复。: Saved Writer preset history cannot be read. Check the database or restore a backup.
内置案例演示两轮写作交流，题材和生成内容留空供手动填写。所有消息与工具步骤都可以: The built-in example shows two writing exchanges, with the topic and generated text left blank for you to fill. All messages and tool steps are freely editable.
将用两轮内置案例替换当前草稿，并关闭注入。点击保存后才会替换已保存的配置。: Replace the current draft with the two-round built-in example and turn off injection. Stored settings are replaced only when you save.
用户消息不能为空。: The user message must not be empty.
助手最终回复不能为空。: The final assistant reply must not be empty.
